title: Open-ended C text-adventure project with optional AI
summary: Second-year electrical engineering students build an open-ended text-adventure game in C over three or four weeks. AI is allowed for the project but prohibited on weekly work; students must submit prompts and responses and record an eight-to-ten-minute code walkthrough and game demonstration.

sources.title: Work in Progress: Integration of AI Tools on an Open-Ended Computer Programming Project
sources.evidence_quote: Their task was to implement a text-based adventure game ... Students could earn an 85% by completing the minimum qualifications.

assessment.summary: Build a map-based text adventure in C with movement, interactions, state tracking, and a win condition, then explain and demonstrate it on video.
student_actions: Design and implement an open-ended text-adventure game in C.
Use functions, structs, arrays, comments, and course concepts.
Document all AI prompts and responses if AI is used.
Record a code walkthrough and game demonstration.

student_role.description: AI is optional for projects and prohibited for weekly assignments.

grading.method: A rubric awards up to 85% for minimum requirements and 15% for a second map and work beyond the base brief.
